prompt: Compose one complete original 30-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: energetic instrumental guitar rock with immediate sparkling riff. Instruments: clean electric guitar, melodic bass, tight acoustic drums. Tempo 130 BPM. Distinct motif: two staccato notes and an octave leap. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 25-second reveal film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:28, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An energetic and funky instrumental track featuring a prominent electric bassline, driving drums, and a catchy electric guitar melody, supported by synth pads. It has a modern retro feel.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和放克风格的纯音乐曲目，以突出的电贝斯线、强劲的鼓点和抓耳的电吉他旋律为特色，并辅以合成器铺垫。它具有现代复古的感觉。
